records.people: Lim Ji-won (member of the Monetary Policy Committee, took office 17 May 2018, four-year term)
records.move: from JP Morgan's Seoul branch (1999 to 2018) to member of the Bank of Korea's Monetary Policy Committee
records.summary: The report states that Lim Ji-won worked at JP Morgan's Seoul branch from 1999 until she took office on the Bank of Korea's Monetary Policy Committee on 17 May 2018. It also reports that she still held 6,486 JP Morgan shares on the day she took office and sold them between July and 7 August 2018, that under the Public Official Ethics Act then in force the limit on share holdings covered domestic stock and not overseas stock, so the holding did not breach the law, and that critics said not selling before taking office was inappropriate given the law's purpose of preventing conflicts of interest. The governor at the time, Lee Ju-yeol, said that if the holding breached the Bank of Korea Act the law should be applied, and that the question was legal rather than ethical. No wrongdoing is implied.
records.status: career move; reported share-holding question, no finding of a breach

records.people: Jaime Valencia Valencia (Gerente General of the Banco Central de Bolivia, sworn in 16 January 2020; earlier Gerente de Operaciones Internacionales)
records.move: from senior posts at Banco de la Union S.A., Banco de Cochabamba and Compania Boliviana de Seguros S.A., among other firms, to Gerente General of the Banco Central de Bolivia
records.summary: The central bank's own press note says Valencia was sworn in as Gerente General on 16 January 2020 and that in his career he held senior posts at a list of organisations that includes Banco de la Union S.A., Banco de Cochabamba and the insurer Compania Boliviana de Seguros S.A., alongside Jindal Steel Bolivia, Ferroviaria Oriental and others. It says he spent 19 years in the private sector before returning to the central bank. The note does not state the ownership of any of the three financial firms and gives no dates or job titles for them, so this record names them exactly as the note does and does not treat them as established private finance.
